preservation.method: Strip only x-claim-requirement and x-claim-row recursively from questions, then require exact equality with public original.
preservation.top_level_changes: case_id/contract revision/instructions are intentionally derivative; no original public question prompt, ID, schema type/shape/description or match rule changes found.

findings.finding: account.last_logon_name is emitted from Winlogon DefaultUserName. A valid setting for A can remain after B successfully logs on, or can be preconfigured before A ever authenticates. Same-part and exhibit gates do not establish the chronologically last successful logon.
findings.required_correction: For the full prompt, declare needs_latest_successful_logon_identity and retain DefaultUserName only as a separate narrow observation. If the intentionally narrowed original schema is retained, explicitly state that setting-only output does not answer the stronger prompt and enforce its required evidence-appendix distinction before launch.

findings.finding: Draft meaning says completed scoped examination. antivirus.extract emits scanner.detections_found=true whenever detections exist, including incomplete scans; only false requires completed allocated scope. A valid true claim therefore need not establish completion. This is independent of exhibit identity.
findings.required_correction: Describe a positive result as at least one scoped signature match without asserting completed coverage; retain the completion prerequisite specifically for false, and enforce review of tool/signatures/coverage/failures required by the original description. If completion for both values is desired, use an unsupported stronger requirement until a completion-bound role exists.

findings.finding: Same typed role from a different image, SAM, filesystem mount or scanner scope can satisfy the leaf and same_claim_part checks. The explicit held state correctly recognizes that source-subject admission is not enforced.
findings.required_correction: Keep model_run_ready=false until the selected-exhibit/source-subject runtime gate exists and has deterministic admission/rejection checks. Counts additionally need SAM/Recycle Bin/filesystem/scanner scope consistent with the requested field; a multi-volume count cannot silently become a case-wide aggregate.

supported_leaf_decisions.rationale: Algorithm/digest plus equality are coherent through root and nested same_claim_part. A standalone acquisition-role algorithm is still a genuine image digest algorithm; if computed digest is present it must come from the same flattened part. SHA256 can be reported as a typed logical hash but is not a supported comparison algorithm.

collection_wrapper_review.decision: Safe separation of scalar examples: each question has one array and independent items, with no composite per-item row whose fields could be mixed. Every item is still unsupported for the missing use, capability, installation/settings link, personal subscription/access or victim attribution rule. No list completeness shortcut is introduced.
collection_wrapper_review.same_part_note: Root Q1 plus nested image_hash protect comparison association; other same-part objects are singleton fields or unsupported multi-field relations. No anyOf bypass is present.

type_and_time_review.decision: No native scalar-type or timestamp-format false promotion found among other supported leaves.
details: Q3 OS install time and Q8 shutdown are typed ISO strings emitted from exact configuration values, not attribute examination timestamps. Identity format preserves the recorded strings; typed attribute formatting cannot reinterpret them as numeric event times.
Q9/Q28/Q30 use native nonnegative integer counters from the reader, not arbitrary record counts or summed observations. Definitions and per-source enumeration scope remain explicit.
Q31 uses native boolean detection result, not a scanner.result string coerced to boolean; completion wording needs the correction above.
No new app.execution roles are used or treated as resolving unrelated actor/last-logon questions.

required_corrections: Resolve Q11 successful-logon versus setting-only answer distinction mechanically or keep the stronger leaf unsupported.
Continue launch hold until selected-exhibit/source-subject and required scoped evidence admission are enforced.
